specs.title: 水平位移云图
specs.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE high-resolution landscape 1536x1024 educational engineering visualization preview. This is explicitly an AI-generated mockup, NOT a simulation and NOT measured data. Clean white background, precise readable Chinese typography, sober engineering report style, generous margins, no software UI, no logos. Prominent footer exact Chinese text: "AI生成示意图 · 非有限元计算结果 · 色标为归一化示意值". All numerical contour values are dimensionless illustrative normalized values, never label them m, Pa or physical strain. Geometry positions use m. Same geometry across this series: symmetric trapezoid road embankment above two rectangular foundation layers. Ground y=0. Crest x=-20 to+20, y=10m; toes x=-35,+35 at y=0; upper foundation y=0 to-8; lower foundation y=-8 to-20; foundation outer boundaries x=-100,+100. Full domain. Horizontal scale exact, vertical drawing exaggerated 3x for visibility and label "竖向显示放大3倍". Thin dark outlines at all material boundaries and faint regular quadrilateral mesh, roughly 2m element grid. Lower boundary fixed and vertical side boundaries rollers, small neat symbols only. Coordinate inset x right, y up. No invented solver status, timestamps, convergence, physical computed maxima or university branding. Title "水平位移云图"; subtitle "U1 · 归一化效果预览". Main visualization shows signed horizontal displacement schematic: mirror antisymmetric lobes concentrated near the left and right toes and upper foundation; blue negative lobe left, red positive lobe right, near-zero neutral white centerline, zero along outer side boundaries and fixed bottom. Symmetric magnitude. Smooth blended isolines, no random noise or disconnected blobs. Diverging blue-white-red colorbar on right ticks -1.0,-0.5,0,0.5,1.0 and label "示意值". Small annotations "左侧向外" and "右侧向外". The centerline is zero, not a red hotspot. Geometric layer lines clearly visible.
